notes.title: New Feature
notes.notes: [p]Hello eveyrone,[/p][p][/p][p]We love seeing you all playing the demo and having fun with it. This is our first game and the reception so far has been beyond our expectations![/p][p][/p][p]We received a lot of feedback from you guys, and the thing that came up the most is the possibility to [b]add your own questions[/b] so we decided to work on that and it will be available the full game.[/p][p][/p][p]Please continue to suggest new ideas through our [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSedncjg5npDzzIX8VrWzoyPOpSbIVbSk10R6qany0wIH4qnwQ/viewform?usp=dialog"]demo feedback form[/url], discord or social media. We love reading them all![/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you all for playing,[/p][p]Hazard Wizard Devs[/p]

notes.title: The demo launches September 11th!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Exciting news today, we are announcing the launch of the Demo, [b][u]on September 11th![/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Featuring a [b]limited set of questions[/b] (300+), and [b][u]only the online mode[/u][/b]. The full set of questions (1000+) and the [b]local mode[/b] will be available in the full game.[/p][p][/p][p]We are planning to keep the Demo live until the full game launch.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622518/7817960bd2f72dd3931a641f962791a086ef9d69.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support, [/p][p][b]Hazard Wizard Devs[/b][/p]

notes.title: New name, new look
notes.notes:
[h2]New name, new look [/h2][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622518/4bc6beff3f8ed24e24bf53812dfcfc3beb72469d.png"][/img][/h2][p]
Hey all👋 Long story short Mail it to the king is now [b]The You Quiz[/b]! [/p][p]We felt the old name didn't reflect what the game was really about, so we changed it ahead of our upcoming demo release. We're super excited about these changes and we feel the game has never looked so good! 
[/p][p]We also revamped the characters to be more colorful and expressive! Which means that we sadly had to retire our old ones, so we say goodbye to the granny, dog and cloud 😢 [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622518/c91e4f9f54d51c14ba21be5725a1e591bfd38c2e.png"][/img][/p][h2]What is coming next[/h2][p]We're getting very close to demo release and we're super excited for you to try it out and tell us what you think. In the meantime you can already play an early version of the demo by registering for the playtest, it will help us iron out bugs in the demo before public release, and you get a glimpse of the development of the game. [/p][p][/p][h2]Wishlist our game today! 👇[/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3669740/The_You_Quiz/#game_area_purchase"][/dynamiclink][/p]
